{{Short description|Brazilian statistician (born 1942)}}
{{Infobox scientist/Wikidata|fetchwikidata=ALL|suppressfields=doctoral_students}}

'''Pedro Alberto Morettin''' (29 June 1942) is a Brazilian statistician, Emeritus professor at the [[Institute of Mathematics and Statistics, University of São Paulo]] and holds a PhD from the [[University of California, Berkeley]]. He also was involved with the Inter American Statistical Institute and the [[International Statistical Institute]].

He is mostly recognized from his works in [[time series]] and [[wavelet]]s analysis.

== Education ==
Morettin studied at the Instituto de Educação de [[Catanduva]], where he had a math teacher who inspired him to persuade this career in this field. Later, Morettin enrolled in the [[University of São Paulo]]'s mathematics program. In 1963, received both bachelor's and licentiate degree. After briefly working as a teacher, Morettin movet to the United States and begun to expand his knowledge of statistics.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2024-11-04 |title=Professor Pedro Morettin é outorgado com o título de Professor Emérito do IME-USP |url=https://www.ime.usp.br/professor-pedro-morettin-e-outorgado-com-o-titulo-de-professor-emerito-do-ime-usp/ |access-date=2025-07-10 |website=IME-USP |language=pt-BR}}</ref>

He earned a master's degree in statistics in 1971 and his PhD in 1972, both from the University of California, Berkeley.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |date=2023-09-01 |title=Galeria de Diretores: Pedro Alberto Morettin |url=https://www.ime.usp.br/historia/galeria-de-diretores-e-vice-diretores/pedro-alberto-morettin/ |access-date=2025-07-10 |website=IME-USP |language=pt-BR}}</ref> There, he studied and became friend with [[David R. Brillinger|David Brillinger]], a friendship that lasted for 40 years. Morettin describes Brillinger's influence in his career as a researcher in the area of time series.<ref>{{Citation |last1=Guttorp |first1=Peter |chapter=Commentary by Pedro A. Morettin |date=2012 |title=Selected Works of David Brillinger |pages=145–148 |editor-last=Guttorp |editor-first=Peter |chapter-url=https://doi.org/10.1007/978-1-4614-1344-8_9 |access-date=2025-07-11 |place=New York, NY |publisher=Springer |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-1-4614-1344-8_9 |isbn=978-1-4614-1344-8 |last2=Brillinger |first2=David |editor2-last=Brillinger |editor2-first=David|chapter-url-access=subscription }}</ref>

== Career ==

=== At the Institute of Mathematics and Statistics, University of São Paulo (IME-USP) ===
Although his initial degree was in [[pure mathematics]], Morettin expanded his knowledge in statistics and began to teach in this field at the Institute of Mathematics and Statistics.<ref name=":0" />

Morettin became the institute's dean in 1990. During his term, he modernized the Department of Statistics, introducing research areas in time series and wavelts and consolidate international partnerships. His warrant lasted until 1994, when [[Carlos Alberto de Bragança Pereira]] assumed.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-07-24 |title=Galeria de Diretores |url=https://www.ime.usp.br/galeria-diretores/ |access-date=2025-07-10 |website=IME-USP |language=pt-BR}}</ref><ref name=":0" />

Until 2012, he was Full Professor at the IME-USP. Later, in 2023, he received the Emeritus title,<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |date=2024 |title=Título de Pesquisador Emérito & Mençaõ Especial de Agradecimentos - Agraciados 2024 - CNPq |url=https://www.gov.br/cnpq/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/acoes-e-programas/premios/pe/copy_of_emeritos_2024_Folder_DIGITAL.pdf |access-date=10 July 2025}}</ref> which is granted to retired teachers who stood out by their research and teaching activities and have distinguished themselves through contributions to the university.<ref name=":0" /> Morettin has built a career at IME-USP that spanned for almost six decades.<ref name=":7" />

Currently, Morettin is IME-USP's Senior Professor and a associated editor of the ''Journal of Forecasting'' and ''São Paulo Journal of Mathematical Sciences.''<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2" />

=== Scientific associations ===
Morettin served as president of the [[Associação Brasileira de Estatística]] from 1994 to 1996<ref>{{Cite web |title=Diretoria – ABE |url=https://www.redeabe.org.br/diretoria/ |access-date=2025-07-10 |language=pt-BR}}</ref> and as president of the Inter American Statistical Institute.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Soares |first=Camila |date=2024-09-30 |title=CONRE-3 participa de homenagem ao Prof. Morettin, da USP – CONRE-3 {{!}} Conselho Regional de Estatística 3ª Região |url=https://www.conre3.org.br/portal/11902-2/ |access-date=2025-07-11 |language=pt-BR}}</ref>

He is a [[National Council for Scientific and Technological Development]] Emeritus researcher and was a associated professor at the Centro de Estudos Quantitativos em Economia e Finanças.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Home {{!}} Ceqef |url=https://ceqef.fgv.br/ |access-date=2025-07-10 |website=ceqef.fgv.br}}</ref>

Morettin held the position of the International Statistical Institute's vice-President and is still listed as a member.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Our Members {{!}} ISI |url=https://isi-web.org/our-members?page=2&country=BR#scroll-to-form |access-date=2025-07-11 |website=isi-web.org}}</ref>

== Legacy ==
Morettin worked extensively with time series,<ref name=":4">{{cite journal|access-date=2025-04-24 |date=1974-04-01 |doi=10.1016/0304-4149(74)90026-X |first=P. A. |issn=0304-4149 |last=Morettin |number=2 |pages=183–193 |periodical=Stochastic Processes and Their Applications |title=Walsh-function analysis of a certain class of time series |volume=2 |url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/030441497490026X|url-access=subscription }}<!-- auto-translated from Portuguese by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> wavelets<ref name=":5">{{cite book|access-date=2025-04-22 |date=1999 |first=Pedro Alberto |language=pt-BR |last=Morettin |publisher=EdUSP |title=Ondas e Ondaletas Vol. 23 |isbn=978-85-314-0509-9 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=n9kPHigs-MsC}}<!-- auto-translated from Portuguese by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> and statistics applications,<ref name=":6">{{cite journal|access-date=2025-04-24 |date=1984 |doi=10.2307/1403247 |first=Pedro A. |last=Morettin |number=1 |pages=83–92 |periodical=International Statistical Review / Revue Internationale de Statistique |title=The Levinson Algorithm and Its Applications in Time Series Analysis |volume=52 |jstor=1403247 |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/1403247|url-access=subscription }}<!-- auto-translated from Portuguese by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> with emphasis in its applications in finances, health and physics.

For his contribuitions in his area, Pedro Alberto Morettin became the first Brazilian to received the Mahalobis Award, granted by the [[Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation]]. The award is conceived since 2003 to a statistic originated in a [[developing country]] who promoted a research area.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |last=FAPESP |title=Destaque em estatística |url=https://agencia.fapesp.br/destaque-em-estatistica/10623 |access-date=2025-07-10 |website=AGÊNCIA FAPESP |language=pt-BR}}</ref>

In addition, Morettin has supervised 46 students in master's and doctoral's degree and has authored books that are widely used in basic courses and advanced ones.<ref name=":3" />

== Awards and recognition ==
[[File:Sriprakash Jaiswal giving away the 4th International Award in Statistics in memory of Prof. P.C. Mahalanobis to Prof. Pedro Alberto Morettin from Brazil, at Durban in South Africa on August 21, 2009.jpg|thumb|right|Morettin receiving the Mahalanobis Internacional Award.]]
* 2006: ABE Awards, from the Associação Brasileira de Estatística.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prêmio ABE – ABE |url=https://www.redeabe.org.br/premio-abe/ |access-date=2025-07-10 |language=pt-BR}}</ref>
* 2009: Mahalanobis International Award, from the India Government.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Mahalanobis International Award {{!}} ISI |url=https://isi-web.org/awards-prizes/mahalanobis-international-award |access-date=2025-07-10 |website=isi-web.org}}</ref>
* 2012: honored with a Workshop at [[Campinas]].<ref>{{Cite journal |date=2012 |title=Boletim da ABE |url=https://www.redeabe.org.br/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/Boletim_82-2012.pdf |journal=Associação Brasileira de Estatística |volume=28 |issue=82}}</ref>
* 2021: Conselho Federal de Estatística's Emeritus Statistic, from the Conselho Regional de Estatística 3ª Região (CONRE-3).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Estatístico Emérito – CONRE-3 {{!}} Conselho Regional de Estatística 3ª Região |url=https://www.conre3.org.br/portal/estatistico-emerito/ |access-date=2025-07-10 |language=pt-BR}}</ref>
* 2023: Instituto de Matemática e Estatística da Universidade de São Paulo's Emeritus Professor, from IME-USP.<ref name=":0" />
* 2024: Conselho Nacional de Desenvolvimento Científico e Tecnológico's Emeritus researcher, from the CNPq.<ref name=":0" />
* 2024: the book ''Time Series and Wavelet Analysis: Festschrift in Honor of Pedro A. Morettin,'' that honors him, was published.<ref name=":7">{{cite book |date=2024 |editor-last=Chiann |editor-first=Chang |editor2-last=de Souza Pinheiro |editor2-first=Aluisio |editor3-last=Castro Toloi |editor3-first=Clélia Maria |title=Time Series and Wavelet Analysis |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-031-66398-7  |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-3-031-66398-7 |isbn=978-3-031-66397-0 |url-access=subscription }}</ref>
